hook: JEF United Chiba had not beaten Kashiwa Reysol away since 2005.

sections.voiceover: JEF United Chiba had not beaten Kashiwa Reysol away since 2005.
b_roll: Historic graphics depicting the derby rivalry timeline leading back to 2005

sections.voiceover: On November 20, 2026, JEF United Chiba played Kashiwa Reysol at Sankyo Frontier Kashiwa Stadium. Who would break the deadlock for JEF United Chiba?
b_roll: Stadium diagram map of Sankyo Frontier Kashiwa Stadium with Matchweek 15 graphic
Attendance counter showing 13,612 spectators and temperature display of 11.1°C

sections.voiceover: But the deadlock didn't hold when midfielder Takumi Tsukui intercepted the ball in the 76th minute.
b_roll: Tactical diagram showing Takumi Tsukui intercepting pass in minute 76

sections.voiceover: Tsukui passed directly to forward Hiroto Goya. A right-footed shot landed in the right corner for the 1-0 lead. That single goal secured JEF United Chiba their third straight win.
b_roll: Pass trajectory graphic from Takumi Tsukui to Hiroto Goya
Shot placement diagram hitting the right corner of the goal net for 1-0 score
Sequence metric visual showing 3 consecutive wins line chart

sections.voiceover: It was their first away win against Kashiwa Reysol since 2005.
b_roll: Final scorecard graphic showing Kashiwa Reysol 0, JEF United Chiba 1
